# AQL built-in functions

**For:** integrators. Every built-in single-row function the AQL parser
accepts, by the group the AQL specification puts it in (QUERY, §Functions).
Names compare without regard to case. How to use them, the aggregates and
FerroEHR's extension functions are on [Querying with AQL](../querying-aql.md).

| Function | Group |
|---|---|
| `LENGTH` | string |
| `CONTAINS` | string |
| `POSITION` | string |
| `SUBSTRING` | string |
| `CONCAT` | string |
| `CONCAT_WS` | string |
| `ABS` | numeric |
| `MOD` | numeric |
| `CEIL` | numeric |
| `FLOOR` | numeric |
| `ROUND` | numeric |
| `CURRENT_DATE` | date and time |
| `CURRENT_TIME` | date and time |
| `CURRENT_DATE_TIME` | date and time |
| `NOW` | date and time |
| `CURRENT_TIMEZONE` | date and time |
